tools.name: search_tests
tools.description: Search the Freudly catalogue of psychological self-assessment tests (personality, anxiety, depression, burnout, relationships, IQ and more). Filter by keywords, topic, language (en, es, ru), maximum duration in minutes and maximum number of questions. Returns test ids, short summaries, duration, num

tools.name: get_test_info
tools.description: Details of one Freudly test by id: description, instructions, the scales it measures, authors and sources, limitations, what the user needs to get the result, and the URL where the test is taken.
